patches.decision_note: The freelancer supplies credential values in direct response to the California PE information request; this is a value update, not an implementation claim.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Marisol, I hope you are doing well. The client contacted me to ask whether you can stamp the changes without redlines, possibly by adding a letter describing the change you are approving. Is that feasible? If it is, I can send you the formal offer. Please also resend the PE name and license number, because I am seeing different information for Nevada PE license 47283 on the PE website. Thanks, Kieran.

ambiguity.description: License 47283 was supplied after the California credential request but is now identified as a Nevada license whose listed identity conflicts with official records, leaving the California credential unresolved.

patches.decision_note: The client's jurisdiction and identity conflict materially undermines the credential previously supplied for the California requirement.
The authorship disclaimer does not independently identify or resolve the California credential and adds no material state after the stronger jurisdiction conflict at message 42.
